turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give Owen a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
I'd like to offer a supervised rewrite.
A rewrite of what, on what evidence? You haven't answered me: who decided on the zero?
Nobody's leaving. Who decided on the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
Sorry. The rewrite would replace the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's your own 4.4, and I'll want it in writing. It doesn't tell me who decided on the zero, or what you're basing any of this on.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you offered Owen a supervised rewrite whose mark would replace the zero, with nothing placed on his record. I still require to know who decided on the zero and on what evidence, and I want the rewrite offer confirmed in writing. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position: your offer met her one non-negotiable, nothing on his record, but she agreed to nothing and still wants to know who decided on the zero, wants to see the evidence, and wants the offer in writing; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, which you named correctly, but she could not take it without evidence first.
What moved her: You said the rewrite would replace the zero and leave his record clean, which answered the one thing she would never trade.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence or answering who decided, and to her accepting it then would have meant admitting something about Owen.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you showed no evidence, so nothing you said came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and why Owen found out on his phone, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then show her one dated document tied to Owen's own work before you mention the rewrite.
Can you give me more detailed feedback? Like a full page?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
